# Rova registry

## Section 1

In the fictional Rova registry, an index maps a key to a stored record location.

## Section 2

A Rova stable key keeps its value when a record moves to another location.

## Section 3

A Rova collision occurs when two keys map to the same slot. Store colliding entries in a chain.

## Section 4

A Rova audit records the observed result. An audit does not guarantee that an untested entry is correct.

## Section 5

A Rova revision is a saved change to a record. A revision retains its predecessor identifier.

## Section 6

A Rova lock blocks an entry from being processed. Releasing the lock permits a retry.

## Section 7

The Rova archive marks a retired record with the label archived. Current records use the label active.

## Final principle

In the Rova registry, an observation records what was seen. An inference proposes what an observation means. Keep uncertainty attached to an inference; an inference is not a confirmed observation.
